entries.34d32c0ec38c2162: In Japan, the company manufactures and sells food products such as surimi products, prepared foods and marine delicacies, and also imports and exports marine products such as surimi, marine processed products and agricultural and livestock products, and sells purchased goods domestically. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥78,167 million. Manufacturing and sales are carried out by the company and its associate Kaiyo Shokuhin Co., Ltd., and import, export and purchase-and-sale are carried out by its subsidiary Kibun Sangyo Co., Ltd.
entries.36f80537d827e2bb: A food manufacturer that manufactures and sells foods, centered on surimi products, and handles logistics for chilled foods.
entries.69aad8184f1ea8b9: Overseas, the company manufactures and sells food products such as surimi products, and also imports and exports agricultural, livestock and marine products such as surimi products and surimi, and sells purchased goods. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,468 million. Manufacturing and sales are carried out by its subsidiary KIBUN (THAILAND) CO.,LTD. and its associate YILIN KIBUN CORPORATION, and import, export and purchase-and-sale are carried out by its subsidiary KIBUN FOODS (U.S.A.),INC.
entries.accc48a5d482eaac: Centered on logistics for chilled foods, it provides contracted services in information services, advertising and sales promotion, office services, food services, and food hygiene inspection and analysis. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥21,401 million. The logistics business is carried out by its subsidiary Kibun Fresh System Co., Ltd., and food hygiene inspection is carried out by its subsidiary Kibun Anzen Shokuhin Center Co., Ltd.
